item.title: Show HN: Visual AI Tutoring in the Browser
item.summary: Been working on this full-time for a few months now. It's an AI tutoring application that takes in context on your page via Desk View, and responds like a real tutor would. It only works in Safari on 2022+ Macbook Pros or 2023+ Macbook Airs. Very particular hardware requirements because it's a new kind of product. Feedback welcome!
